## Claim & Evidence

**Claim:** 菖蒲 (chāngpú) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Acorus calamus (the rhizome) — with an aroma profile of herbal, spicy, sweet, earthy. Note: calamus oil can contain β-asarone, restricted in food use in some jurisdictions.
